# Vetta 0.6.23
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-25 -->

## English

### New

- You can now edit and resend any earlier message, not just the last one. The agent answers again using only the conversation before it; the original and what followed stay as another version you can switch back to on the bubble.
- With input prediction on, the first suggestion appears as faded text in the empty input box; press Tab to fill it in, or type or press Esc to dismiss it. The toggle moved from Settings → Agent to Personalization, and stays as you set it.

### Improvements

- On Windows, button groups drop the glass effect, and the buttons at the bottom of the sidebar and on the right of the title bar have no background until you hover or select them. macOS and Linux are unchanged.

### Fixes

- SSH hosts can now be connected on Windows. Each action opens its own connection, so running commands takes one extra handshake and hosts with two-step login may ask you to verify more than once.
- Remote hosts whose login shell is csh or tcsh now connect and work normally, including running commands, reading and writing files, and background tasks.
- On Windows, an SSH host that can't be reached is now reported as a connection failure instead of a failed remote command.

## 中文

### 新增

- 较早的提问也能编辑重发，不再只限最后一条。改完发送后，模型只沿用这条之前的对话重新回答；原提问和后面的对话保留为另一个版本，可在气泡上切换回去。
- 开启输入预测后，第一条预测以淡色显示在空输入框里，按 Tab 填入，打字或按 Esc 即放弃；开关从「设置 → Agent」移到「个性化」，原有设置不变。

### 改进

- Windows 上按钮组去掉玻璃效果，侧边栏底部和标题栏右侧的按钮平时没有底色，只在悬停或选中时显示；macOS 和 Linux 不变。

### 修复

- Windows 上可以连接 SSH 主机了。每次操作单独建立连接，执行命令会多一次握手，开了两步验证的主机可能会多次要求验证。
- 登录 shell 是 csh 或 tcsh 的远端主机现在能正常连接，执行命令、读写文件和后台任务都可用。
- Windows 上连不上 SSH 主机时，会提示无法连接，而不是报远端命令执行失败。
